title: TanStack Router
description: A type-safe, file-based routing library for React by TanStack.

data.text: TanStack Router is a type-safe, file-based routing library for React. It provides full TypeScript support with inferred route params and search params, built-in caching, and code-splitting. It is part of the TanStack ecosystem alongside TanStack Query.

data.title: Type-Safe Route Definition
data.content: Define routes with full type inference for params.

terms.definition: Route params and search params are fully inferred by TypeScript, preventing runtime errors.
Routes are automatically generated from your file system structure.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: TanStack Router offers full TypeScript type safety
Built-in caching and search param validation
data.takeaway: TanStack Router is the type-safe choice for modern React applications.
